name: Bill Monroe and the Blue Grass Boys

podcast.title: Origin of "Bluegrass"
podcast.body: The genre of music became known as "bluegrass" after Bill Monroe's band, the Blue Grass Boys, in which Earl Scruggs played in the 1940s. "bluegrass became the name for their genre of music."

srcs.episode: Ep. 46 - The Chaos and Music of the Ozark Music Festival of 1974

podcast.title: Scruggs' Banjo Playing
podcast.body: Bill Monroe was profoundly impressed by Earl Scruggs' fast and lightning-quick banjo playing. "Monroe was completely blown away by the way Scrugg's played the banjo."
